details.detail: Wing planform, sweep, raked tip. Correct against ACAP and the cruise photos.
In-flight bending. Plausible against ANA _7345 and EK 2015.

Upper-skin surface. The panel tone is faint, and fastener rows now exist: the fine leading-edge row reads well. Near the root in 17A, the 62 % chord row reads as a coarse dashed road-marking line (dashes about 0.3 m) and not as a rivet row. Still no grime or streaks.
Gear-alignment stripe. Plausible. Still the heaviest mark in 17A.
JA795A registration. Upright and left to right, grey block capitals at 50 % chord. I accept B's one-to-one measurement against _7345.
Slat nose band and control-surface seams. Fine.
Canoe tone. Matches the ANA _7345 ratio on the shaded side. The sun side is plausibly light.
Canoe shape. Smooth teardrops ending in about 8 cm rounded tips (k_canoe_side). They read like _7345 from 26K.

Cowl surface, shaded (A) side. Now matches ANA 11A _136 closely. From 13A it is #8b9eb5 at the top and #7b8ca5 low, against the photo's #8d96a6 and #78889a. From 11A it goes #d2d8de to #95a2b3 (0.7). It reads as a solid, shaded white cowl, still blue-tinted by the pale sky (owner: lighting).
(owner: lighting, item 6) Cowl surface, sun side. Still clipped flat white from 13K (#d9dcdf and #e7e9eb, unchanged even at albedo #b0b3b7). That confirms it is an exposure problem.
Pylon fairing hump. A smooth blister, close to ANA _137.
Strake and access panel. The strake, now in cowl colour with its root seam, reads as in _137. The panel is visible in the studio.
Nav and strobe lights. The nav lens now sits flush in the tip leading edge (j_tip).
(owner: lighting) Day sky. Unchanged pale #acc2d7, against the #114892 to #2472ca cruise references.
(owner: lighting) Sunset: sky, deck, cream canoes, near-white cowl. Unchanged.
(owner: lighting) Night: no beacon wash or strobe lighting. Unchanged.

issues.detail: The inboard fastener row reads as a painted dashed line.
issues.problem: Near the root, the dashes of the 62 % chord row are long and well spaced. From 17A they read like a road marking or walkway boundary, not like rivets.
issues.evidence: /tmp/r7/d_17A.png (zoomed wing root) against the fine dot row in alv_*_7345.
issues.fix: 11_exterior.js fastener rows: shorten the dashes to about 0.03 m on and 0.12 m off, lighten the material from #4c4f54 to about #6a6d72, and keep w 0.02. Alternatively use a continuous 0.012 m line at that colour, which reads as a rivet row at 10-30 m.

issues.detail: The upper wing has no grime or streak variation.
issues.problem: The wing is still clean CG grey. ANA _7345 shows faint chordwise streaks aft of the spoilers and grey mottling.
Still open: sun-side cowl clipping (item 6), the pale day sky that tints the cowl blue, the sunset sky, deck and cream canoes, the near-white sunset cowl, and the missing night beacon.
issues.evidence: /tmp/r7/d_13K.png, d_13A.png, s_26A.png, s_13A.png, n_17A.png against the refs in exterior_w1a.json.
